methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
UN News — Human Rights is the topic-scoped RSS 2.0 feed of the United Nations news service (news.un.org) filtered to the human-rights desk. It reports on OHCHR, the Human Rights Council, special rapporteurs and independent experts, treaty bodies and country-situation coverage on civil, political, economic and social rights.

## Search
Client-side keyword filtering over RSS item title/description; no server query API. The feed URL scopes content to human rights on the server side; any finer keyword match (a specific right, mechanism or country) must be applied in-memory as a substring scan over each item's title and description.

## Filters
Topic scoping to human rights is fixed by the feed URL. Beyond that only client-side filters apply: publication date range (from pubDate) and keyword. Items carry no per-item `<category>`/`dc:subject` tags, so no secondary category filter is available.

## Download
The retrievable document is the item `<link>` HTML article page (e.g. news.un.org/en/story/...). Each item also has an `<enclosure>` pointing to a JPEG lead image, not a PDF; no direct document downloads are offered.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Not supported.

## Limitations
Feed returns only the most recent ~30 items (observed span July back to late May); no historical pagination beyond the feed window.
probeNotes: Reachable, valid RSS 2.0. Observed 30 items spanning Jul 2026 back to 29 May 2026. Fields: title, link, description, guid, pubDate, enclosure (JPEG). No <category>/dc:subject tags. No PDF links.
